name: Iris December Uncry
original_name: アイリス・ディセンバー・アンクライ
source:
The princess of the Kingdom of Uncry, the forgotten kingdom of winter. She has come to the surface to get people to remember her home kingdom. Despite doing her best to act bright and cheerful, she struggles to survive the surface's summer heat.

“I promise I will restore the Kingdom of Uncry to its former glory!”
